Test Case Name: Verify Tile Visibility and Status Display for All Roles
Description: Verify the "Processing status" tile is visible and correctly displays icons for saved, for approval, and approved statuses for all user roles.
Pre-conditions: A Writer user is logged in. Records exist in "saved", "for approval", and "approved" states.

Step Description: Observe the tile for a "saved" record.
Expected Result: The tile displays an entry with a save icon.

Step Description: Observe the tile for a "for approval" record.
Expected Result: The tile displays an entry with a single orange tick icon.

Step Description: Observe the tile for an "approved" record.
Expected Result: The tile displays an entry with a green double tick icon.

Step Description: Log out and log in as a Viewer user.
Expected Result: The "Processing status" tile is visible and displays the same icons for the records.

Step Description: Log out and log in as an Admin user.
Expected Result: The "Processing status" tile is visible and displays the same icons for the records.

Test Case Name: Verify Pop-up Activation and Navigation to Original Mask
Description: Verify that clicking the tile opens a pop-up and allows navigation back to the original mask to continue the release process.
Pre-conditions: A Writer user is logged in. The "Processing status" tile is visible and shows at least one action.

Expected Result: A pop-up appears, showing details of the actions being processed.

Step Description: Click on the selectable area for a specific action within the pop-up.
Expected Result: The user is navigated to the original mask (the "Bearbeiten" page) for that record.

Step Description: On the original mask, verify that the release process can be continued (e.g., the 'Send for Approval' button is enabled for a saved record).
Expected Result: The user can continue the release process from the original mask.

Test Case Name: Verify Behavior with No Active Processes
Description: Verify the system's behavior when the "Processing status" tile is present but there are no actions in a "saved", "for approval", or "approved" state.
Pre-conditions: A user is logged in. No records are in a pending state.

Step Description: Observe the content of the tile.
Expected Result: Insufficient information to determine. The tile should display a clear message indicating no active processes.

Step Description: Observe the content of the pop-up.
Expected Result: Insufficient information to determine. The pop-up should display a clear message indicating no active processes.

Description: Verify that a user with the "Viewer" role can see the tile and pop-up but cannot interact with the release process.
Pre-conditions: A Viewer user is logged in. The "Processing status" pop-up is open.
Step Description: From the pop-up, click the selectable area for an action.
Expected Result: The user is navigated to the original mask in view-only mode.

Step Description: On the original mask, observe the available actions.
Expected Result: All fields are disabled, and only the "Schließen" (Close) button is enabled, preventing the user from continuing the release process.
